name: zcode-ops
description: One Codex to orchestrate every agent, starting with ZCode.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate your agent team from Codex. ZCode first.
interface.longDescription: Eight tools inspect existing ZCode desktop tasks, read conversations or a durable inbox, send authorized prompts through one on-demand queue, control delivery, select advertised models, and manage the Sharing Link. Single and batch sends share the same path; explicit pause persists. Legacy ACP diagnostics are not exposed by default. Future support for other desktop agents will follow verified interfaces.
